policy_attribution_correction.dependency: The historical HIAL leaf held local full CI; the director pre-push full-CI policy consequently held push; without push no new GitHub push-event run could start. Git transport and Linux GitHub runners have no direct dependency on macOS startup. The director publication-before-assessment order supersedes that blanket hold, without claiming the historical cause repaired.
